summary: Session-to-menu mode switch called after race completion. Reads a shifted byte field from dword_5EA43C: if non-zero it forces dword_7C569C to 6 and calls MainMenuTransition to enter the main menu; otherwise, when dword_7CE814 is zero, it runs the post-race one-time init path (ReciprocalWithSignCheck on flt_5EA4E8 with 0.5, then GlobalStateOneTimeInitializer on unk_7CE24D). Both branches return 0.

operations.description: Entry branch on the shifted byte field extracted from dword_5EA43C; non-zero selects the main-menu transition path.
ByteFieldExtractorWithShift(&dword_5EA43C) reads and extracts a shifted byte field from dword_5EA43C (setup-directory suffix flag) to choose the menu mode path.
On the menu path, set dword_7C569C to 6 (session type).
MainMenuTransition(&dword_5EA43C) transitions the game to the main menu screen.
On the non-menu path, the post-race init sequence runs only when dword_7CE814 is zero (qualifying DSQ not enabled).
ReciprocalWithSignCheck(&flt_5EA4E8, 0.5) computes a reciprocal with sign check on the post-race offset flag flt_5EA4E8.
GlobalStateOneTimeInitializer(&unk_7CE24D) performs one-time initialization of the session transition state.

unresolved: Enum meaning of the dword_7C569C value 6 and the exact semantics of the byte field extracted from dword_5EA43C are only context-derived.
Identity and layout of flt_5EA4E8 and unk_7CE24D remain names-by-context; no field offsets are grounded here.
Which caller (RaceFinishHandler, sub_4A0CB0, LapCompletion) triggers which branch is not resolvable from this function alone.
Legacy ABI label Session_Menu_Mode_Switch is retained but not independently corroborated.
